A '''droid tool kit''' or '''droid repair kit''' was a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] intended to help an individual to perform repairs on [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. They were readily available for sale throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and generally cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS" />
